C0552.title: Exploiting 'Instant Refund' Policy to Swap Counterfeits for Authentic Goods for Profit
C0552.summary: Starting January 2021, the defendant Xiaoming ordered branded sneakers and down jackets on an e-commerce platform, then exploited its 'Instant Refund' policy by returning cheap substitutes purchased elsewhere to obtain refunds while selling the authentic items on another online store, defrauding over 890,000 yuan.

references.title: 'Couponing' Can Also Be Illegal! Highlights of Online Shopping Dispute Cases on 'Double 12'
Defendant Sentenced to Three Years for Buying Genuine Goods and Returning Counterfeits Fraud of Over RMB 890,000 on an E-Commerce Platform
